en.headline: Thunderstorm Warning extended until 4:30 pm as squally storms persist
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory extended the warning first issued at 10:35 a.m., expecting a few more squally thunderstorms over the territory this afternoon.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory said the Thunderstorm Warning issued at 10:35 a.m. on 17 August has been extended until 4:30 p.m. A few squally thunderstorms are still expected to occur over Hong Kong.

Members of the public are advised to seek safe shelter if outdoors, leave the water and avoid outdoor water sports, and keep away from high ground, trees and highly conductive objects when thunderstorms occur.

The Very Hot Weather Warning also remains in force. The Observatory earlier noted that high temperatures were triggering thundery showers, with heavier rain and strong gusts possible over parts of the territory.

zh.headline: 雷暴警告延長至下午4時30分 預料仍有狂風雷暴
zh.dek: 天文台將今早10時35分發出的雷暴警告有效時間延長至今日下午4時30分，預料香港仍有幾陣狂風雷暴。
body: 香港天文台表示，今日上午10時35分發出的雷暴警告已延長至下午4時30分，預料香港仍有幾陣狂風雷暴。
市民在雷暴發生時應到安全地方躲避，離開水面，切勿進行戶外水上活動，並遠離高地、樹木及導電物體。
酷熱天氣警告仍然生效。天文台較早前指出，高溫觸發的雷雨正影響本港，部分地區雨勢較大及有狂風雷暴。
